name: Tamper Detection
description: Detect tampering: missing entries, altered receipts, broken hash chains, backdated entries. Alert and escalate.
purpose: Tampering is detected, not just prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing entries are detected by sequence gap analysis.
Altered receipts are detected by hash chain verification.
Broken hash chains trigger immediate alert.
Backdated entries are detected by timestamp monotonicity checks.
Tamper events escalate to security council within a defined SLA.
